name: Integral Measure and Disjoint Intervals
description: Replaced the explicit multiplicative power-of-two equations with definite integrals of 1/x, and replaced the algebraic non-overlapping condition with a geometric disjoint open intervals condition. This prevents models from syntactically extracting p1+p2>T and forces them to reason through the properties of logarithms and measures of disjoint sets to discover the underlying additive bottlenecks.
